simple.meaning: גְּמוּל (gᵉmûwl) is a Hebrew object word meaning “treatment , i.e. an act (of good or ill); by implication, service or requital.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Judges 9:16. The surrounding context includes family line, righteousness, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גְּמוּל (H1576) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: גְּמוּל (gᵉmûwl) / H1576 is traced through Judges 9:16, 2 Chronicles 32:25, Psalms 28:4, Psalms 94:2 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: “Now therefore, if you have dealt truly and righteously, in that you have made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done to him according to the deserving of his hands
But Hezekiah didn’t reciprocate appropriate to the benefit done for him, because his heart was lifted up. Therefore there was wrath on him, and on Judah and Jerusalem.
Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings.
Rise up, you judge of the earth.
Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction,
A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth.
He who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh;
Tell those who have a fearful heart, “Be strong!
A voice of tumult from the city,
“Flee out of the middle of Babylon!
You will pay them back, Yahweh,
For the day of Yahweh is near all the nations! As you have done, it will be done to you. Your deeds will return upon your own head.

definitions.full: H1576. gemul גְּמוּל noun masculine dealing, recompence, benefit — ׳ג Psa 94:2 11 t.; suffix גְּמֻלְךָ Obadiah 15, etc.; plural suffix גְּמוּלָיו 103:2 ; — 1 יָדַיִם גְּמוּל dealing of the hands Judg 9:16 ; Prov 12:14 ( לְ יָשׁוּב ) Isa 3:11 ( לְ יֵעָשֶׂה ). 2 dealing , hence (from context) equivalent of dealing, recompence: with suffix Obadiah 15 בראשׁך ישׁוב גמלך , Joel 4:4; Joel 4:7 ( הֵשִׁיב ), so with לְ הֵשִׁיב Psa 28:4 ; לְ שִׁלֵּם 137:8 ; Prov 19:17 ; absolutely לְ גְּמוּל ( הֵשִׁיב ) שִׁלֵם Isa 59:18 (twice in verse); 66:6 ; Jer 51:6 ; Lam 3:64 ; עַל Joel 4:4; Psa 94:2 ; Isa 35:4 אלהים ׳ג the recompence of God. 3 benefit: גמוליו כל תשׁכחי אַל Psa 103:2 ; עליו כגמול according to the benefit (done) unto him 2Chr 32:25
